name: autonomous-work-loops
description: Bootstrap and arm a reviewed, converging, multi-agent implement/review/fix PR loop in a repo. Tag an issue 'ready'; loops claim it, open a proven PR, wait for hosted checks, ingest inline bot review feedback, adversarially review and fix it until convergence, then label it ready-for-human or ready-for-human-baseline-red. Use when the user mentions work loops, autonomous PRs, an implement/review/fix loop, or a ready label.
